speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your symptoms, have you noticed any fluctuation in your muscle strength throughout the day, such as worsening in the evening or improving after rest? Additionally, do you experience any ptosis (drooping eyelids) or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any difficulty swallowing, speaking, or breathing, especially later in the day? I will now request a specific blood test to check for antibodies associated with neuromuscular junction disorders. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing those details. Given your fluctuating weakness, ptopsia-like symptoms, and the positive antibody test, the diagnosis is quite clear. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
